Compact WSON/VSON/SOT-563 packages demand tight hot-loop layout and thermal vias.

Fixed-output variants save divider BOM; adjustable parts allow arbitrary rail tuning up to switch BVdss limits.
Continuous DC output current rating; verify inductor Isat >= Iout + ΔIL/2 and thermal margin.

swap_risks: CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: AP62200WU-7 specifies 2000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs AP62300WU-7 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Verify continuous load current and peak inductor saturation margin (Isat >= Iout + ΔIL/2).

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP62200WU-7: -40..125 °C Industrial / Extended (-40°C to 125°C TJ) vs AP62300WU-7: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C TA; -40°C to +125°C TJ)); AP62300WU-7 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AP62200WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) and AP62300WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because current rating or switch-limit basis differs; ambient temperature grade differs (-40..125 °C vs -40..85 °C). Power-stage deltas: buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency 750 kHz (p.5) vs 750 kHz (p.5) (1x ratio), typical inductor 3.3 µH (p.17) vs 3.3 µH (p.17), feedback Vref 0.8 V (p.5) vs 0.8 V (p.5), and package θJA 70 vs 70 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP62200WU-7 "CRITICAL: EN Pin Abs Max Is ONLY 8.0 V — NEVER Tie Directly to 12 V / 18 V VIN!" (p.4) and AP62300WU-7 "CRITICAL: Pin 5 (EN) Abs Max Is ONLY 8.0 V — Direct 12 V VIN Tie Destroys AP62300WU-7" (p.4). BOM decision: Choose AP62200WU-7 when matching your existing Diodes Incorporated TSOT-23-6 (TSOT26) qualification and -40..125 °C grade; choose AP62300WU-7 when higher load current capacity (3000 mA) is required. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.1) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
